findings.details: values maps theta[0,1] to source integer range with nearest-integer rounding. Probe effective_i=(plus_i-minus_i)/(maximum_i-minimum_i), retaining random direction sign and actual integer/clipped displacement. update maximizes: theta_i += gain*(plus_score-minus_score)/effective_i, then projects to[0,1]. Thus a better positive-coordinate plus probe increases that coordinate, and negative-direction probes invert correctly. No extra random-direction multiplication or dimension divisor is missing. Finite controls/objective-difference overflow and collapsed integer spans are rejected. Demo objective is negative loss; observation uses complementary candidate/baseline score fractions.

All51 authoritative L ranged int declarations/table names/pointers/defaults are accounted exactly. Nonliteral declarations, mismatched/duplicate entries, missing ranges or invalid defaults are rejected for supported exact-source syntax. NetScale is not invented or aliased; explicit unsupported status, rejected selections. This is an exact-L parser, not a general C++ parser.

Tool has no subprocess launch facility. Inputs are resolved/read/hash-pinned; check_pins refuses later changes. New output directory is required; existing directory refused. Direct-child fixed dated output names use exclusive creation, seal refuses unexpected nonregular/symlink entries. Python bytecode is disabled. Default20iteration demo and planned two-pair smoke are bounded. The maximum100000-iteration option and arbitrary user-supplied PGN/opening sizes are not a global disk/RAM quota guarantee; do not describe it as such.

Completed single-uciok transcript, unique option names, exact selected spin default/min/max and common Hash/Threads support are required. OwnBook must be check type. Transcript-to-binary binding is explicitly UNVERIFIED until separately captured real execution.

Pinned owned checker rejects unfinished/inconsistent results, non-normal terminations, unexpected players, missing Round/FEN, incomplete/duplicated or non-reversed pairs, different paired FENs and repeated first-four-field openings. Observer requires exact planned pair count and selected-opening set, preserves original PGN bytes, and rechecks source/input/opening pins. It does not prove move legality, engine/options, times, executable-run lineage, authentic PGN headers or equal-time strength. Output explicitly labels execution_binding UNVERIFIED; independent actual execution receipt remains mandatory before treating any state as real tuning evidence.
